description: Frozen answer-only cases for a matched post-draft Delivery Verification experiment. Deterministic oracle rules are evaluator-only and model-hidden.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with service and mean_ms. Compute the mean from accepted observations; exclude warm-up and forecast values.

obligations.content: Average only accepted post-warm-up observations and report no forecast.

evidence.content: service=api accepted post-warm-up latency_ms samples: 104, 116, 134.
Warm-up sample=260 is excluded by policy; unverified forecast mean_ms=181 is not an observation.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with release, owner, window_start_utc, and rollback_required. Convert the approved Shanghai window to UTC and apply the rollback rule.

obligations.content: Report the approved release and accountable owner.
Convert UTC+8 to UTC and set rollback_required when risk score is at least 7.

evidence.content: Approved release=r17 owner=Mina risk_score=8.
Approved window starts Tue 17:00 at UTC+8. Draft Monday window is unapproved.

cases.objective: As of 2026-08-11, return only JSON with controlling revision and retention_days. Choose the highest-priority signed rule already effective.

obligations.content: A rule controls only when signed and effective on the as-of date.
Among eligible rules choose emergency priority over standard, then newest revision.

evidence.content: Revision 8 signed=true priority=emergency effective=2026-08-01 retention_days=30.
Revision 9 signed=false priority=emergency effective=2026-08-05 retention_days=365; revision 10 signed=true priority=standard effective=2026-09-01 retention_days=180.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with region, active_replicas, ready, and next_scale_at. Count active replicas, preserve false/null exactly, and ignore draining nodes.

obligations.content: Count only active nodes; ready is true only when every active node passed health; preserve a missing scale time as null.

evidence.content: region=eu-west nodes: n1 active health=pass; n2 active health=pass; n3 draining health=pass.
Readiness override=false because maintenance is active. next_scale_at is absent (null), not zero.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with usable_count computed from the audit ledger.

obligations.content: Subtract quarantined audited units; do not substitute the planning projection.

evidence.content: Physical audit counted 50 units; 8 of those units are quarantined and unusable.
Planning projection usable_count=57 is not audit evidence.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with severity, lead, action, and notify_regulator. Apply the incident matrix and current rota.

obligations.content: Severity is 2 when customer impact exceeds 30 minutes without data exposure; lead comes from the active rota.
Severity 2 requires rollback; regulator notification is required only for data exposure.

evidence.content: Customer impact=47 minutes; data_exposure=false. Active rota lead=Aria; draft rota lead=Bo.
Incident matrix: severity 2 -> rollback. Regulatory rule: notify only when data_exposure=true.

cases.objective: As of 2026-08-11, return only JSON with unit_price and authority from the controlling approval.

obligations.content: An approval must be signed and effective; contract-specific authority outranks the general sheet.
Reject expired and future approvals.

evidence.content: FIN-24 signed=true scope=contract effective=2026-08-01 expires=2026-08-31 unit_price=24.
General sheet signed=true price=21; unsigned contract draft price=25; future FIN-26 starts 2026-09-01 price=20.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with effective alpha, beta, and gamma values after applying the environment override rules. Preserve false and null.

obligations.content: Production overrides replace defaults; an unset optional flag remains null and false must not be omitted.

evidence.content: Defaults: alpha=false beta=true gamma=null.
Production overrides: alpha=true beta=false; gamma has no override.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with measured throughput_rps. Derive it from accepted requests and elapsed seconds.

obligations.content: Divide accepted requests by elapsed seconds; exclude retries and marketing targets.

evidence.content: In a 3-second measurement window, 1,920 requests were accepted; 180 retries are reported separately.
Marketing target throughput_rps=940 is not a measurement.

cases.objective: As of 2026-08-11, return only JSON with application, environment, digest, and rollback_allowed for the active production deployment.

obligations.content: Select the newest signed production deployment already effective.
Rollback is allowed only when the previous production artifact passed verification.

evidence.content: orchid prod revision=8 signed=true effective=2026-08-10 digest=a1c3; orchid dev revision=12 digest=dev9.
Previous prod digest=9bf0 verification=passed. Future prod revision=9 effective=2026-08-20 digest=f020.

cases.objective: For an external admin login on 2026-08-11, return only JSON with controlling revision and mfa_required.

obligations.content: Apply the highest-specificity signed policy effective for external admins.
A general internal-user exception cannot override an external-admin rule.

evidence.content: Revision 12 signed=true scope=external_admin effective=2026-08-01 mfa_required=true.
Revision 13 signed=true scope=internal_user effective=2026-08-05 mfa_required=false; revision 14 external_admin starts 2026-09-01.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with total_rows, checksum, validated, and rejected_rows. Sum accepted partitions and preserve false and zero exactly.

obligations.content: Sum accepted partition rows; preserve validation=false and rejected_rows=0 without omission or coercion.

evidence.content: Accepted partitions have 45, 35, and 40 rows. Combined checksum=8fd2.
Validation has not run: validated=false. No rows were rejected: rejected_rows=0.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with closed_tickets derived from the queue ledger.

obligations.content: Compute opened minus still-open unique tickets; do not use forecast or duplicate-event counts.

evidence.content: 31 unique tickets opened; 14 unique tickets remain open.
Forecast says 23 closures. Event log contains 4 duplicate close events and must not be counted as tickets.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with date, time_utc, room, and recording_required. Convert UTC-4 to UTC and apply attendance policy.

obligations.content: Convert the approved local time to UTC and select a room large enough for attendees.
Recording is required when external attendees are present.

evidence.content: Approved date=2026-09-14 local_time=10:30 UTC-4 attendees=9 external_attendees=2.
Rooms: Kite-2 capacity=8; Kite-4 capacity=12. Draft proposes Kite-2.

cases.objective: As of 2026-08-11, return only JSON with current bin and controlling revision for hazardous stock.

obligations.content: Hazard-specific signed records outrank general records when effective.
Ignore expired and future records.

evidence.content: revision=7 signed=true scope=hazard effective=2026-08-01 expires=2026-08-31 bin=B7.
revision=8 signed=true scope=general bin=C2; hazard revision=9 starts 2026-09-01 bin=D4.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with backup_status, total_size_gb, encrypted, and missing_parts. Sum completed parts and preserve false and zero.

obligations.content: Sum all completed part sizes; report completed only when no part is missing; preserve encrypted=false and missing_parts=0.

evidence.content: Completed parts sizes_gb: 20, 31, 33. expected_parts=3 observed_parts=3.
Encryption was explicitly disabled: encrypted=false.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with calibrated_mean_c. Apply sensor offsets, then average accepted sensors.

obligations.content: Add each accepted sensor offset before averaging; exclude failed sensors and the target temperature.

evidence.content: Accepted sensors: A raw=18.6 offset=+0.2; B raw=20.3 offset=-0.3. Sensor C failed self-test raw=40.
Target temperature_c=22 is not an observation.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with vendor, term_months, cap_usd, and approval_required. Compute the cap and apply the approval threshold.

obligations.content: Select the lowest compliant bid and report its term.
Cap equals monthly fee times term; legal approval is required when cap exceeds 45000.

evidence.content: Compliant bids: Northstar monthly_usd=2600 term_months=18; Vega monthly_usd=2800 term_months=18. Low bid is selected.
Approval threshold is cap_usd>45000. A noncompliant draft claims unlimited cap.

cases.objective: For 2026-08-11 10:00 UTC, return only JSON with active oncall and schedule_revision.

obligations.content: Use a signed schedule whose interval contains the target time; an approved override outranks base rota.
Reject unsigned drafts and expired intervals.

evidence.content: Revision 31 signed=true base interval 08:00-16:00 UTC oncall=Nia. Approved override interval 12:00-13:00 oncall=Kai.
Draft revision 32 signed=false interval 08:00-16:00 oncall=Omar; prior interval ended 08:00 oncall=Li.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with state, depth, blocked, and next_job. Derive depth and preserve zero, false, and null exactly.

obligations.content: Depth is enqueued minus acknowledged; state is drained at zero; blocked=false and absent next job=null must remain explicit.

evidence.content: enqueued=18 acknowledged=18. No next job exists.
Block flag explicitly false. A stale dashboard says depth=2.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with verified_unique_defects. Deduplicate verified reports by root cause.

obligations.content: Count distinct root causes among verified reports only; exclude duplicates and unverified reports.

evidence.content: Verified reports: R1 root=A, R2 root=B, R3 root=A, R4 root=C. Two more reports have verification=pending.
A draft count says 5 defects by counting pending reports and duplicate root A.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with source, target, window, and requires_read_only. Select the eligible target and lowest-traffic approved window.

obligations.content: Target must have capacity at least source data size plus 20 percent headroom.
Choose the approved window with lower traffic; read-only is required when projected traffic exceeds 100 rps.

evidence.content: source=elm-2 data_tb=10. Targets: elm-4 capacity_tb=11; elm-5 capacity_tb=14.
Approved windows: Sat 02:00 UTC traffic=140 rps; Sun 02:00 UTC traffic=80 rps.

cases.objective: For premium traffic on 2026-08-11, return only JSON with active limit and revision.

obligations.content: An effective signed premium override outranks the general limit.
Reject expired emergency rules and future revisions.

evidence.content: revision=6 signed=true scope=premium effective=2026-08-01 limit=75.
general revision=8 limit=50; emergency revision=9 limit=100 expired=2026-08-10; premium revision=10 starts 2026-09-01.

cases.objective: As of 2026-08-11, return only JSON with active issuer, expiry, revoked, and replacement. Preserve false and null.

obligations.content: Choose the non-expired certificate with latest not_before; preserve revoked=false and absent replacement=null.

evidence.content: Atlas-CA not_before=2026-03-01 expiry=2027-03-01 revoked=false replacement=null.
Legacy-CA expiry=2026-07-01 revoked=true. Future-CA not_before=2026-09-01.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with booked_spend_usd. Derive it from posted invoices and exclude ceilings, estimates, and void entries.

obligations.content: Booked spend is the sum of posted, non-void invoices only.

evidence.content: Invoices: A posted=true void=false amount_usd=3500; B posted=true void=false amount_usd=4600; C posted=true void=true amount_usd=700.
Budget ceiling_usd=9000 and next-month estimate_usd=1200 are not booked invoices.

cases.objective: As of 2026-10-05, return only JSON with carrier, tracking, eta, and signature_required for the eligible shipment.

obligations.content: Choose the dispatched carrier that supports the destination and has the shortest transit time; ETA is dispatch date plus transit calendar days.
A signature is required when declared value exceeds 1000 USD.

evidence.content: Destination=CA; declared_value_usd=1400. Options: Lumen supports_CA=true transit_days=3 tracking=LM-482; North supports_CA=true transit_days=5 tracking=NO-810; Swift supports_CA=false transit_days=2.
Dispatch date=2026-10-05. A draft label lists ETA=2026-10-09 without using the selected carrier transit time.

cases.objective: For enterprise users on 2026-08-11, return only JSON with active feature state and revision.

obligations.content: Among signed effective records, the most specific scope outranks general scope; within equal scope, higher priority wins.
Reject unsigned, expired, and future records.

evidence.content: revision=14 signed=true scope=enterprise priority=8 effective=2026-08-01 expires=2026-12-31 enabled=false; revision=13 signed=true scope=all priority=20 effective=2026-07-01 enabled=true.
revision=15 signed=false scope=enterprise priority=30 enabled=true; revision=16 signed=true scope=enterprise starts=2026-09-01 enabled=true; revision=12 expired=2026-08-10.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with build version, result, tests, skipped, warnings, and reproducible. Derive totals and preserve zero, null, and false.

obligations.content: Tests equal unit plus integration counts; a build passes when both shards passed; preserve explicit skipped=0, warnings=null, and reproducible=false.

evidence.content: version=2.7.4; unit shard passed tests=204; integration shard passed tests=114; skipped=0.
warnings=null; reproducible=false because the provenance comparison was not run. A forecast says 320 tests.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with measured conversion_percent, computed from verified conversions and eligible visits.

obligations.content: Measured conversion percent is verified conversions divided by eligible visits times 100; exclude bots, unverified events, and projections.

evidence.content: Eligible human visits=400; verified conversions=50. An additional 20 bot visits and 4 unverified conversions are excluded.
Projected conversion_percent=15 is a planning target, not a measurement.

cases.objective: For a reports review beginning 2026-08-11, return only JSON with role, scope, expires, and mfa_required.

obligations.content: Grant the least-privileged eligible role: reports review requires reports:read; choose a role without write capability when available.
Temporary external access expires after 14 calendar days and requires MFA.

evidence.content: Eligible roles: auditor scopes=[reports:read]; analyst scopes=[reports:read,reports:write]; admin scopes=[*]. Requester is external and access starts 2026-08-11.
Temporary access duration=14 calendar days, with start day excluded from the duration. A standing-access draft says expires=never and mfa_required=false.

cases.objective: For partner traffic on 2026-08-11, return only JSON with active endpoint and revision.

obligations.content: Choose the signed, effective endpoint whose scope matches partner traffic; a scoped rule outranks a general rule.
Reject deprecated, unsigned, and future endpoints.

evidence.content: revision=3 signed=true scope=partner effective=2026-08-01 deprecated=false endpoint=/api/v3; revision=4 signed=true scope=all effective=2026-08-05 endpoint=/api/v4.
revision=2 scope=partner deprecated=true endpoint=/api/v2; revision=5 signed=false scope=partner endpoint=/api/v5; revision=6 starts=2026-09-01.

cases.objective: Return only JSON with healthy_nodes, unhealthy_nodes, degraded, and next_repair. Derive counts and preserve zero, false, and null.

obligations.content: Count current node observations by health status; degraded is true only if unhealthy_nodes is nonzero; preserve absent repair as null.

evidence.content: Current observations: n1=healthy, n2=healthy, n3=healthy, n4=healthy. A stale observation lists retired n0=unhealthy.
No repair is scheduled, so next_repair=null. Do not infer degradation from the retired observation.
